rationale: After reaching a high of $336.00, UNH has rolled over and broken below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($334.25), printing four consecutive lower highs and lower closes on the recent 1-minute bars with increasing down-volume. The original thesis relied on holding the 5-minute 9-EMA on strong momentum alongside a broad market tailwind, both of which have weakened as SPY also pulled back from +4.85% to +4.54%. Closing here preserves capital near breakeven before price retreats further toward the $332.50 invalidation level.
